title: Beeping sound at startup
symptom: PC beeps repeatedly at power on and does not start
user_description: I turned on my computer and it beeped several times. Now the screen is just black and Windows doesn't start.

options.text: Ignore it, it will sort itself out
options.why: Beeps at startup are the PC reporting a fault. Ignoring them wastes time and may hide a failing part.

options.text: Count the pattern of beeps and look it up in the manufacturer's beep code guide for that exact model
options.why: Beep patterns are a built-in way for a PC to report hardware faults, but the meaning differs between manufacturers and models. The exact pattern plus the model gives the right answer.

options.text: Assume three beeps always means bad memory and replace the RAM
options.why: Beep codes are not the same on every computer, so guessing from one pattern can send you after the wrong part.
Expensive and premature. Most beep faults are simpler, such as a loose memory module or card.

hints: Is the PC trying to tell you something?
Do all computer makers use the same beep patterns?
Where would you find the meaning for this exact model?
real_world_tip: Newer PCs often use a coloured or flashing light code instead of beeps. Check the manual for the light pattern too.
